Kerr’s Merry Melodies tune index

A searchable index of all 1769 tunes in James S. Kerr’s four Collections of Merry Melodies for the Violin (Glasgow, c. 1880s) — Scotch and Irish reels, strathspeys, jigs, hornpipes, schottisches, country dances and waltzes, still a staple of Scottish and Irish fiddlers. Filter by book, sort by book order to browse the sets as printed, and open any tune for Kerr’s own setting with playback.

825 tunes link to their page on thesession.org, where many go by other names — those are shown under the title.
